title: Quick Creamy Malaysian Shrimp Paste Gratin
description: A show-off Malaysian dish featuring shrimp paste, brine-wet, and high in protein. Serve with steamed vegetables or a side salad.
instructions: Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and just cooked through, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Set the shrimp aside on a plate.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter and the shrimp paste.
Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, until the shrimp paste is fragrant and slightly darkened.
Stir in the coconut cream, fish sauce, brown sugar, and lemon juice.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly thickened.
Stir in the cornstarch, if using.
Add the cooked shrimp back to the sauce and stir to coat.
Transfer the shrimp and sauce to a baking dish and top with grated cheddar, if using.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped scallions or chives, if desired.
